## `POST /plans`

Plan replicas, HPA and totals from the runs' capacity models.

**Request body:** [PlanCreate](/reference/api/models/#plancreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [Plan](/reference/api/models/#plan) |

## `GET /scenarios`

Saved scenarios, newest first.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                 |
| ------ | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [ScenarioResource](/reference/api/models/#scenarioresource) |

## `POST /scenarios`

Save a scenario under a name; its runs must exist and its request must be valid.

**Request body:** [ScenarioCreate](/reference/api/models/#scenariocreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                        |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [ScenarioResource](/reference/api/models/#scenarioresource) |

## `POST /scenarios/evaluate`

The workbench's recompute: the same as POST /plans (models, inputs, overrides).

**Request body:** [PlanCreate](/reference/api/models/#plancreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [Plan](/reference/api/models/#plan) |

## `DELETE /scenarios/{scenario_id}`

Deletes a saved scenario.

| Parameter     | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `scenario_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /scenarios/{scenario_id}`

Returns one saved scenario.

| Parameter     | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `scenario_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [ScenarioResource](/reference/api/models/#scenarioresource)       |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |
